[Verse 1]
[F#5]Staring out
of my window
[D#5]Watching the clouds
go rolling by.
[B5]My friends are gone
I've got nothing to
[C#5]do.
[F#5]So I sit
here patiently,
[D#5]watching the clock
tick so slowly.
[B5]Gotta get away,
or my brains will ex-
[C#5]plode.

[Chorus]
[B5]Give me something to [F#5]do
to kill some
[C#5]time.
[B5]Take me to that [F#5]place
that I call
[C#5]home.
[B5]Take away the [F#5]strains
of being
[C#5]lonely.
[B5]Take me to the tracks
[F#5]at Christie
[C#5]Road.

[Verse 2]
[F#5]See the hills
from afar.
[D#5]Standing on
my beat up car.
[B5]The sun went down
and the night fills the
[C#5]sky.
[F#5]Now I feel
like me once again.
[D#5]As the train comes
a rolling in.
[B5]Smoked my boredom gone,
slapped my brains up so
[C#5]high.
